REQ-AUTO-198A6A47509791DF: Issue #482 reported that absolute error and move folder paths made the file watcher ignore every file under `/` (maintainer CorentinTh, 2025-09-08). The fix accepts absolute paths and skips only files under those folders. Why the watcher must skip its own error and move folders: reason not stated.
REQ-accounts-can-enable-two-factor-authe: Requested in issue #695 by elte0 (2025-12-20): "this is crucial for an app that stores highly sensitive documents." The maintainer stated no reason of his own; the issue was closed as a duplicate of #652.
REQ-built-in-content-extraction-can-be-t: Requested in issue #926 by vinodmishra (2026-02-24), who runs an external n8n extraction pipeline: "I have no need for the content extraction being done by Papra" and "often have to forcibly wait before I run my n8n pipeline on the uploaded document". The maintainer stated no reason of his own.
REQ-when-a-generated-storage-key-collide: Maintainer CorentinTh on issue #440: suffixes handle the case "if someone uploads two files that produce the same path" (2026-02-04), counter suffixes are used "as done by many OSes" (2026-02-04), and "The system has mechanisms to avoid data loss for non-deterministic patterns" (2026-03-01). Existing documents keep their old path "as their storage path is saved in the database" (2026-02-04). The storage key docs add that a final collision fails the upload "rather than overwriting existing data".
REQ-documents-are-stored-as-ingested-wit: Maintainer CorentinTh on issue #440 (2026-02-26) states the behaviour and points to the no-mutation principle in the architecture docs, which gives the reason: users archiving important documents "need absolute confidence that their files remain untouched".
REQ-files-matching-ingestion-folder-igno: Requested in issue #881 by Webreaper (2026-02-09): Synology "creates lots of metadata files that shouldn't be imported." The maintainer agreed to add them to the default exclusion list without a reason of his own.
REQ-intake-email-addresses-can-follow-a-: Requested in issue #486 by GoldenGamerLP (2025-09-09): the random names are "slightly weird or suspecious in the case you need to send something from work to papra." The maintainer stated no reason of his own.
REQ-ocr-text-extracted-from-scanned-pdfs: Maintainer CorentinTh on issue #353 (2025-06-13): "As an archiving platform, Papra should guarantee document integrity", and "modifying the original document goes against that principle".
REQ-tag-name-and-colour-are-validated-se: Maintainer CorentinTh on issue #222 (2025-04-17): "a stricter and complete validation is done server side in the api schema". The issue author had found that any text was accepted as a colour in the form. Why the server schema rather than the form is the guard: reason not stated beyond that remark.
REQ-the-documents-page-keeps-the-current: Requested in issue #743 by estrella159 (2026-01-13): "It would enable browser search shortcuts, quick searching from the address bar, bookmarkable and shareable searches". The maintainer stated no reason of his own.
REQ-webhooks-emit-document-updated-docum: Requested in issue #428 by rafidalhaque (2025-07-20), because tags are added after creation ("as we have to add tag later than creation"). The maintainer added the events on 2025-07-25 without a reason of his own.
REQ-per-document-expiry-dates-are-not-a-: Maintainer CorentinTh on issue #413 (2026-03-07): "Closing the issue as it would be supported by custom properties". Why custom properties rather than a dedicated expiry feature: reason not stated beyond that.
REQ-a-soft-deleted-organization-can-be-r: The organization deletion docs say the two-phase deletion "provides a grace period for recovery while ensuring eventual cleanup of resources". Why only the deleting user may restore, and why recovery ends at scheduledPurgeAt even before the purge runs: reason not stated.
REQ-the-purge-task-deletes-an-expired-or: The organization deletion docs: documents are handled in batches "to avoid memory issues with large organizations", and the task logs file deletion errors "without blocking the entire purge operation".
REQ-on-self-hosted-instances-the-first-r: The roles guide: assigning admin to the first user "simplifies initial setup by ensuring you have admin access from the start", and the user-count check with idempotent role assignment is there "to prevent duplicate admin grants" when several users register at once.
REQ-inbound-intake-email-webhooks-are-si: The OwlRelay setup guide: the secret is transmitted to the relay to sign its requests, "to authenticate that the emails are coming from OwlRelay".
REQ-the-application-package-is-versioned: The versioning docs: the Docker image version always matches the application package version, "ensuring consistency across distribution methods". Why the app uses CalVer and libraries SemVer: reason not stated.
REQ-when-several-versioned-key-encryptio: The encryption guide: versioned keys exist for key rotation, which "allows you to replace encryption keys without losing access to existing documents".
